title: From becomes beneath, behind, or under
summary: Corrected under/behind prepositions, retained explicit family phrases, and preserved the newer F048 corrections.

user_response.text:
Here are the direct Celan wording fixes:
1. Sentences needing morl (under / beneath)
"The sharp grain rests by the water under the light."
Old Celan: Pelvar nor dren thal shal.
Updated Celan: Pelvar nor dren morl shal.
"The storm flows with the water under the light."
Old Celan: Dralorim nor dren thal shal.
Updated Celan: Dralorim nor dren morl shal.
"The trap is beneath the bridge."
Old Celan: rinaen vethbel thal njor.
Updated Celan: rinaen vethbel morl njor.
"The cousin is by the water under the mountain."
Old Celan: Pralin ser dren thal morl.
Updated Celan: Pralin ser dren morl morl.
"The distant relative is by the water under the family."
Old Celan: Zharin ser dren thal Tharvok.
Updated Celan: Zharin ser dren morl Tharvok.
"The bond renewal flows under the mountain."
Old Celan: Zhivokesh shalil thal morl.
Updated Celan: Zhivokesh shalil morl morl.
2. Sentence needing vethvar (behind)
"I hear music behind the house."
Old Celan: aenaen I aennor thal teremil.
Updated Celan: aenaen I aennor vethvar teremil.
3. Sentences needing an thal (in/under balance)
"The shadowlight ritual strengthens with the family under balance."
Old Celan: Shalorveth kal dren thal Tharvok.
Updated Celan: Shalorveth kal dren an thal.
"The fortress bonding ceremony is with the family under balance."
Old Celan: Kalorinath ser dren thal Tharvok.
Updated Celan: Kalorinath ser dren an thal.
